verdict.rationale: Pulumi's docs name stacks and per-stack config as core concepts ("projects, stacks, config, secrets"; "Manage infrastructure, secrets, and configuration"), and CLI operations such as preview are scoped to a stack. Community users report managing 5+ environments and reusing the same stack structure across them, which supports the per-environment stack model. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs mapping stacks to dev/staging/prod environments, details on per-stack config files and values, and hands-on detail of an environment-promotion workflow.
